title: Book Page Count Too Low or Too High? Minimum & Maximum Pages for KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu, B&N | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix "page count is below the minimum" (or over the maximum)
description: Your book has too few or too many pages for the format you chose. See the page limits for KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble Press and Lulu, and how to fix it.
platforms: Amazon KDP · IngramSpark · Barnes & Noble Press · Lulu
lead: Every printer has a smallest and largest book it can bind. Fall outside it and the file is refused before anything else is checked.
error: Page count is below the minimum (or above the maximum) for this format
errorNote: Paraphrased. Each printer words this a little differently.
why:
Binding machines need enough pages to glue a spine, and can only hold so many. The limits SparkPrep uses for paperbacks:

PrinterFewest pagesMost pages
Amazon KDP24828
IngramSpark181,200
Barnes & Noble Press48800
Lulu32800

Limits can change with trim size, paper and color, so always confirm on your printer's own calculator. Remember the printer counts every page in the PDF, blank pages included.
manual: Export your interior as a PDF and read the real page count there.
Compare it with your printer's limits for your trim size and paper.
Too few pages: add real front and back matter (title page, copyright page, table of contents, about the author) or choose a smaller trim size. Too many: choose a bigger trim size or split the book.
Re-export the PDF and update the page count (and your cover's spine) in your book setup.
Re-upload it to your printer and wait for the file review again. If it fails, you start over.

cta.text: SparkPrep checks your page count against your printer's limits the moment you set up your book, before you upload anything.

faq.q: What is the minimum page count for a KDP paperback?
Do blank pages count toward the page count?
faq.a: Yes. Printers count every page in the PDF, including blank ones.
